snippet.title: Keyboard Warrriors - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4254500/Keyboard_Warriors/

Type to kill in this roguelite experience where every keystroke unleashes destruction on your enemies. Customise your mech and make builds to survive the wasteland, typing out the story of the world to power your killing machine.
